To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we isolated a novel cannabinoid from CBD extracts of hemp, we unambiguously identified it and we synthesized it.

we have isolated, characterized and named a novel cannabinoid, cannabidibbutol (CBDB), that we have developed and validated an HPLC-UV method for its qualitative and quantitative determination in samples of CBD.

we have isolated and identified a new cannabinoid, named cannabidibotul (CBDB), that was previously unknown, we have synthesized it and we have developed an analytical method for its quantitative determination.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new natural cannabinoid isolated from CBD extracted from hemp.
the isolation, the characterization and the synthesis of CBDB, a novel cannabidi analog, and its determination in hemp extracts.
the characterization of an important impurity of CBD extracted from industrial hemp and its identification as cannabidibutoxide.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the second natural impurity of CBD, which is supposed to be a butyl analog of the main active principle, has been isolated and characterized for the first time.
the second impurity is not a butyl analog of cannabidiolic acid, as previously reported, but the butyl analog itself of CBD.
CBDB is a new cannabinoid present in hemp and that it is not the result of a synthetic contamination.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the novel cannabidibotol, the butyl analog, is the second impurity in CBD from hemp and that it is a new natural compound.
the novel cannabinoid, cannabidibutoxide (CBDB), is a new natural impurity of cannabidiols (CBDs) from hemp.

the isolation, characterization and synthesis, along with the analytical method for the determination, of CBDB, the second major impurity of CBD extracted from Cannabis sativa, are reported for the first time in literature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of CBDB in CBD extracted from hemp is unavoidable.
CBD extracted from hemp, even though produced under GMP regulations, can be contaminated by CBDB and CBDV.
the CBD extracted from hemp can be contaminated with CBDV and CBBD.
